summary: /commit leaves its own review lanes' Coherence journal files behind after every landing
evidence: preflight computes --paths before /code-review spawns qa-swarm lanes; each lane's SubagentStart (and the Codex router's SessionStart) writes a new .coherence/decisions/<agent>.jsonl holding only '(session opened)'; land.ts commits only --paths, so 4 such files stayed after 9426abf3 and 5 needed the manual chore commit 755c0b86
